The missing source-unitary composition is implemented locally as `6390706c`
on `issue-123-source-unitary-composition-20260918`. The new
`exists_extractionWitness` constructs the global witness internally and applies
the proved conditional extraction theorem. Universal constants precede the
parameters and strategy; both players, concrete swap unitaries, normalized
auxiliary state, state/Pauli bounds and nested error scale are retained.

MAIN checked the clean six-file113+/27- commit, unchanged producer proof
bodies, and14 artifact hashes. Fresh probes for the new theorem and both
producers have only standard axioms. Focused Lean and aggregate builds,
blueprint render/sync, gap checks and ordinary hooks passed. Full CI and
independent review remain pending; the author audit is not an approval of the
source-level completion marks. Review must independently assess the source
assumptions, enlarged nested error scale and retained conditional Unfaithful
markers. Final isometry transfer, Pauli soundness and parent #123 remain open.

Sol/Ultra Boole (`01a0b0e3-04c0-7ea1-82b5-339e966a1653`) completed
19:41:03.134Z-19:53:47.596Z,764.462 seconds within900. Actual task delta:
6771969 input/6609152 cached input/25547 output/8299 reasoning tokens. The
thread retired, claim released, and terminal evidence is archived in
`native-audits/issue123-source-unitary-01a0b0e3/terminal.jsonl`. The completed
packet is queued for publication and normal gates without re-authoring or
resetting any earlier analytical attempt budget.

The sole native is now fresh Sol/Ultra Popper
(`01a0b0f9-8b40-7e83-a940-01ebed38be6f`), reviewing PR #580 at `4bd78e34`.
MAIN acquired the atomic claim, verified all nine CI contexts, rooted audit
1619 pass/0 fail/4 statement-only warnings, and warmed a separate detached
review tree. All five files receive independent code and prose review from
trusted published-main `dc959fca`. Neither #580 nor original #543 has a prior
formal review. The existing proof-attempt history remains recorded.
The reviewer must rebuild the changed Consistency artifact before its axiom
probe because the main cache still contains that theorem's old proof hole.
Its600-second budget reserves the final120s for publication/receipt; actual
start/deadline/model/effort/delta/rollout are recorded in
`native-reviews/pr580-4bd78e34-01a0b0f9/admission.jsonl`.

#456 remains owned by its content-integration fixer; #299 and #481 follow in
merge order. Fresh Opus reviewers hold #581 and #582; #271 is handed back at
`5840bcbb` with green CI and needs the bounded terminal finding assessment.
MAIN reiterated its four-review history and the prohibition on an automatic
fifth full-review loop. Lower-priority review completion does not move main
ahead of the critical queue.

The required snapshot completed. The previous cycle is progress (#518 closed
with fresh evidence and this composition task admitted). Caps0/0/0, one native,
no lanes, only daemon merges, no #168 post. The full formalization goal remains active.
